{{Top|leg}}
'''Service Code 1''' was a regulation in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. [[Elara Dorne]], a defector from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], used her right under the code to an immediate personnel hearing, and used the hearing to demonstrate that [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Kalor (Republic)|Kalor]] of the [[Personnel Division of the Army of the Galactic Republic|Personnel Division]] had wasted thousands of credits and man hours in a pointless investigation with the intent of proving Dorne a traitor.
